result:
I searched every `.ts`/`.tsx` file for references to `PlanId` and checked each usage site.

Of the 22 files that mention the string "PlanId", 20 actually name the type in code (import, type annotation, type argument, or `Record<PlanId, …>` key position) and would need to be opened when a new plan is added:

- `src/types/billing.ts` — declares the `PlanId` union itself and uses it in `PLAN_IDS`/type fields.
- `src/types/feature-flag.ts`, `src/types/organization.ts`, `src/types/event.ts` — import and use `PlanId` in field/type-argument positions.
- `src/config/plan-limits.ts` — imports `PlanId`, uses it as a `Record<PlanId, PlanLimits>` key and in function signatures.
- `src/schemas/billing.ts` — imports `PlanId` for a `satisfies` parity check.
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts`, `src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts`, `src/server/db/seed.ts` — use `PlanId` in signatures/fields.
- `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` — `Map<OrgId, PlanId>` and function signature.
- `src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx`, `src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx` — props typed with `PlanId`.
- `src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx` — `Record<PlanId, string>`.
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx` — function parameter typed `PlanId`.
- `tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/config/nav.test.ts`, `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`, `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`, `tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts` — import and annotate with `PlanId`.

I excluded two files that only mention "PlanId" inside plain string literals used for manifest/documentation generation (not real TypeScript type positions, so they need no edit when the union grows): `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts`. I also confirmed files that only consume plan data via `PLAN_IDS`/`getPlanLimits`/`planIdSchema` (e.g. `tests/config/plan-limits.test.ts`, `src/schemas/feature-flag.ts`, `src/schemas/organization.ts`, `src/server/db/schema/billing.ts`) never name `PlanId` itself, so they're correctly out of scope per the task's carve-out.

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/organization.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/schemas/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/lib/rate-limit.ts, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx, src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx, src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx, tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts
